Consolidate critical-density collapse and rigidity in one manuscript. Positive densities at the exact critical norm cap retain uniform weighting-law marginals through every fixed power L^alpha, alpha<1/2, while their top two transfer eigenvalues tend to one. Conversely, bounded critical norm and exact matching with k^2/(L ln(L+1)) tending to infinity force operator-norm convergence to unweighted noise. The quantitative proof explicitly derives a quadratic deficit from the credited Kirshner--Samorodnitsky moment formula; it retains the level-sum prefactor and does not claim a sharp square-root transition or necessary logarithm.
